target: courier acceptance to recorded delivery completion, minutes

study_plan.geographic_holdout_policy: No Jilin model fitting, model selection, or deadline calibration. Evaluate its October records only after selection locks. Causal historical Jilin event-log inputs are permitted, so this is model transfer, not a no-history cold start.
study_plan.label_availability: Train/tune/calibration outcomes must complete before the next partition. October test keeps all supplied outcomes for accepted October tasks.
study_plan.training_budget: Up to approximately 250000 rows per known city, selected as whole courier/acceptance-day groups with seed 42. Shared and local models use identical selected training cases. Historical features use all strictly prior logged events, not just sampled fitting rows.
study_plan.evaluation_sampling: None: use all eligible validation, calibration, and October test rows.
study_plan.selection_metric: Unweighted mean of city-level Sep 1-15 MAE across the four known cities
study_plan.pooled_weighting: Equal total training weight per known city; equal total validation weight per city for early stopping
study_plan.local_fallback: Use pooled_context for the unseen Jilin city
study_plan.deadline_calibration: Compare pooled residual, city residual, and region residual (minimum 200 calibration cases, otherwise city then pooled fallback). Never use Jilin or October outcomes to set buffers. Do not select a deadline variant using October results.
study_plan.test_status: Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Chongqing October have not been evaluated locally before this study; Yantai October is exploratory/reused. Jilin is a geographic stress holdout. Keep these strata separate in reporting.
study_plan.stop_rule: One bounded shared/local/blended comparison; no further parameter changes in response to October or Jilin results within this run.

fresh_three_city_day_bootstrap.caveat: Descriptive whole-day bootstrap with jointly sampled calendar days; serial dependence, one seed, and geographic selection limit inference.

limitations: Fitting uses a bounded whole-courier-day training sample; all eligible validation/calibration/test rows are evaluated. Historical event features use the complete prior log.
Yantai October was previously inspected. Three other known-city October tests were first evaluated here; Jilin is held out from fitting, tuning, and calibration.
Jilin transfer still uses strictly prior local operational history as input. It is not a no-history cold-start guarantee. Local and blended policies fall back to pooled_context there.
Four ID/type fields are scoped by city to avoid accidental namespace collisions. Held-out city IDs become missing for native categorical model inputs.
A frozen model sees updated causal event history. Missing/uncompleted tasks and real ingestion delays are not fully represented by this completed-task dataset.
90% deadline coverage is a target, not a guarantee. City is the preselected primary buffer method; pooled/region versions are diagnostics, not test-selected winners.
Calibration includes only outcomes known before Oct 1; delayed outcomes near cutoffs can bias tail estimates downward. All supplied October-accepted outcomes remain in testing.
One seed and one six-month source. Macro-city metrics prevent larger cities dominating the headline, but do not guarantee performance for each small region or outside these five cities.
Calendar assumes 2022 from the author README. Coordinates are privacy-perturbed; no inferred real identities, live road traffic, vehicle types, future routes, or actual earnings.
No poisoning injection/countermeasure or deployment validation. All data/model/prediction artifacts remain local; dataset licensing conflict remains unresolved for redistribution.
ai_disclosure: AI assistant authored the experiment and tests under user direction. Models execute locally; no raw data sent to an external model API by these scripts.
